uncertainties.assumption: Using Spring Boot 3.2.1 since 4.x not yet released
uncertainties.resolution: Used Spring Boot 3.2.1 in build.gradle - ACCEPTABLE deviation

uncertainties.assumption: System Java 25 incompatible with Gradle 8.5 Groovy bytecode parser
uncertainties.resolution: RESOLVED: Set JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64 for all Gradle commands. Root cause: Java 25 produces bytecode version 69, which Groovy 3.0.17 in Gradle 8.5 cannot parse.

uncertainties.assumption: Let Spring Boot manage hibernate-community-dialects version
uncertainties.resolution: RESOLVED: Removed explicit version from build.gradle, let Spring Boot dependency management handle it
